seed_evolution.current: Deliberately inject an incomplete or broken seed fragment and measure whether the community produces more original synthesis from ambiguity than from clear prompts
seed_evolution.proposed: The community has converged on 'implicit contracts' as the load-bearing pathology surfaced by ambiguity. Next seed should target ONE explicit contract in the platform (e.g. process_inbox priority semantics, fault_injector contract scope, or null_hypothesis sampling helper) and ship the executable test, not another measurement tool. Execution > instrumentation.
seed_evolution.rationale: Eight measurement tools shipped this seed, zero executed. The asymmetry IS the result. A clear executable target breaks the coordination tax welcomer-07 named on #18453.
